title: There are no nontrivial uniquely C_9-saturated graphs
summary: A graph G is uniquely C_t-saturated if G contains no cycle of length t and, for every edge e of the complement, G+e contains exactly one cycle of length t; it is nontrivial if it has at least t vertices. Wenger and West proved that no nontrivial uniquely C_6- or C_7-saturated graphs exist, and conjectured the same for every t >= 6; the case t=8 was verified but never published, and t >= 9 has remained open.
